core_details.description: Contractor will be replacing culvert on Bunker Road near Capehart Housing Area. Allow time for traffic control. Visitors entering the park should expect delays. Visitors exiting park will be routed over Conzelman Road.

core_details.name: Traffic Delays for Bunker Road and Baker-Barry Tunnel June 30, 9am to 3pm
core_details.road_names: ['Bunker Road', 'Baker-Barry Tunnel', 'Conzelman Road']
core_details.description: Roads crew will be cleaning the Baker-Barry tunnel in Marin Headlands. Traffic entering the park will experience up to 20-minute delays. All traffic exiting the park will be routed over McCullough to Conzelman Road.
